english.text: Doctor Rosen led a team that studied about twenty healthy people. The team examined the people with functional magnetic resonance imaging devices. MRI’s can show changes in the flow of blood and the amount of oxygen in the blood. They studied the people before, during and after acupuncture. The researchers placed acupuncture needles in the skin on the peoples’ hands. They chose places linked to pain relief in traditional Chinese acupuncture.

english.text: The 2nd of March of 2022 was somewhat uneventful. I went to the pizzeria in the morning. There were some old folk with white hair. Homebound, I saw on the sidewalk an Oriental boy squatting, wearing orange and yellow. He got up and walked away. Some landscapers were at a yard. There was an orange-vested handsome labourer fiddling with his machine tool by his vehicle. For lunch and dinner at home, it seemed special with steamed tofu and fish on rice.

text: 2021年11月8號朝早8點前喺咖啡館，我坐喺度飲緊冰綠茶同食緊香蕉麵包。前枱坐咗個菲律賓女人用手機講緊塔加洛文。一個着住藍灰衫嘅啡色頭髮大男人喺櫃檯度等緊。 喺我返屋企嘅路上，經過一個黑衣啡髮女仔同一個黑衣啡髮男仔，佢哋大叫：「佢哋覺得世界語似小提琴多啲 …… 」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Jai and I had a discussion about religion. He noted that I was being a Buddhist in a principally Christian family. He thinks that my funeral would be Christian, despite me being Buddhist. I said that it did not really matter what others thought. I knew that Jai liked Zen Buddhism, but was affected by his German wife Erika's Lutheran background. Jai's family in India was Hindu. I read that one of the ways a Buddhist monk could attain more enlightenment was if he lived in a cemetery. For me, having moved from Vancouver to Lulu Island was like moving to a cemetery. In fact, I am an Animist-Buddhist.

text: 我同 Jai 有個關於宗教嘅討論，佢指出我係一個主要係基督教嘅家庭入面嘅佛教徒。佢覺得我嘅葬禮會係基督教嘅，明明我係佛教徒。我話其他人點諗都唔緊要。我知道 Jai 鍾意禪宗，但係受到佢德國老婆 Erika 嘅路德教背景影響。Jai 喺印度嘅家庭係印度教徒。我睇到一個佛教僧侶可以得到更多啟蒙嘅其中一個方法，就係如果佢住喺墳場。對我嚟講，由溫哥華搬去露露島就好似搬咗去墳場噉。事實上，我係一個無神論者 - 佛教徒。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I knew Bratislav, of Croatian descent, personally since 2012, but I had seen him walking his two small dogs in the Lulu Island neighbourhood park in previous years without talking to him. Bratislav was unique in my opinion, as he had a really different reality view than everyone else, it seemed. He recounted stories of farm cows, whose bodies were sapped of blood by UFO aliens and engraved with circles. Ghost-like aliens could phase out of this material world, as they could pass through walls, he said. He said that there were secret space missions about which the public did not know. He was like no other person that I had met.

text: 我由2012年開始就親身認識克羅地亞血統嘅布拉迪斯拉夫，但係我喺往年見過佢喺露露島鄰近嘅公園散步佢兩隻小狗，都冇同佢傾過計。布拉迪斯拉夫喺我嘅意見入面係獨一無二嘅，因為佢對現實嘅睇法似乎同其他人唔同。佢講返啲農場牛嘅故事，佢哋嘅屍體被 UFO 外星人吸咗血，仲刻咗圈圈。佢話，好似鬼咁嘅外星人可以逐步離開呢個物質世界，因為佢哋可以穿過牆壁。佢話有啲秘密太空任務係公眾唔知嘅。佢好似我未見過嘅其他人噉。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Housing is a big problem in our adopted country because the locals are not protected from rich foreign investors of land property. In my home country, foreigners are not allowed to buy land, but are allowed to buy only condominiums. Land speculation has driven prices up in places here where there is no culture, scenic view, or other worthwhile features.
